prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', 'sign_in, reorder', and 'adoption, redesign' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, and 14 were underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -0.7% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +2.6% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +0.1% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +3.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.2%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] upload_photos_compact_layout_redesign: Redesign the photo upload screen into a compact layout with streamlined image drop targets. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (68.4%) and long median duration (89s), indicating Friction in photo uploading.)
1: [home, wait_info] waiting_progress_time_estimate_notification: Display an explicit time estimate and visual progress bar while pet generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a high median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user dropout while waiting for generation.)
2: [finish, new_screen] new_pet_care_guide_screen: Add a dedicated pet care guide screen at the end of onboarding highlighting daily interactions. (why: Support receives frequent inquiries after onboarding regarding how to interact with, control, or care for the pet.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] story_compact_layout_redesign: Redesign the intro story screen into a compact layout for quicker reading. (why: The initial path selection step has a long mean time of 514s, showing early user hesitation on introductory screens.)
4: [adoption, layout] adoption_certificate_centered_layout: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a centered layout to highlight completion. (why: Simplifying the adoption certificate layout helps users finish the adoption stage quickly without drop-off.)
5: [home, notification] waiting_ready_notification_flow: Enable desktop notification alerts when the pet finishes generating on the waiting screen. (why: Users background the app during the long generation wait (mean 2336s) and need an alert when it finishes.)
6: [finish, redesign] home_intro_checklist_layout_redesign: Redesign home intro screen into a checklist layout summarizing main desktop controls. (why: Multiple support tickets mentioned confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet once onboarding finishes.)
7: [choose_path, hint] choose_path_time_estimate_hint: Display a estimated completion time hint on the choose path screen. (why: Setting clear time expectations encourages users to complete the initial setup steps.)
8: [finish, new_flow] new_desktop_setup_check_flow: Add a desktop setup verification flow screen after home intro to confirm pet rendering on desktop monitors. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not show on desktop or the app fails to open properly after setup.)

scores.note: Adoption step has the highest drop rate (31.6%); adoption redesign historically shows +2.6% lift.
Addresses high median wait time on home step (201s/2336s) with clear progress expectations.
Support mail points to care questions, but finish new_screen historically yields minimal lift (+0.1%).
Targets high mean duration (514s) on initial choose_path step with a compact UI layout.
Minor layout adjustment targeting the high-friction adoption stage.
Re-engages backgrounded users during very long generation wait times (2336s mean).
Strongly supported by support feedback; finish redesign changes historically yield +3.8% lift.
Config/text change providing setup time expectations at minimal cost.
Addresses support issues via new flow, but adding new screens/flows historically shows negligible lift.
